intro.quote: Link-Local addresses are for use on a single link.  Link-Local addresses have the following format:

fields.explain: The fixed 10-bit binary prefix identifies a Link-Local unicast address.
This 54-bit field is fixed to zero.

fields.name: interface ID
fields.explain: The interface ID is 64 bits long and is constructed in Modified EUI-64 format.

cite.quote: For all unicast addresses, except those that start with the binary value 000, Interface IDs are required to be 64 bits long and to be constructed in Modified EUI-64 format.

intro.quote: Site-local addresses are now deprecated as defined in [SLDEP].

fields.explain: The fixed 10-bit binary prefix identifies the deprecated site-local address space.

fields.name: subnet ID
fields.explain: This 54-bit field contains the subnet ID.

fields.name: interface ID
fields.explain: The interface ID is 64 bits long and is constructed in Modified EUI-64 format.

cite.quote: For all unicast addresses, except those that start with the binary value 000, Interface IDs are required to be 64 bits long and to be constructed in Modified EUI-64 format.

intro.quote: A second type of IPv6 address that holds an embedded IPv4 address is defined.  This address type is used to represent the addresses of IPv4 nodes as IPv6 addresses.

fields.explain: This 80-bit prefix is fixed to zero.

fields.name: FFFF
fields.explain: This 16-bit field contains the fixed value FFFF.

fields.name: IPv4 address
fields.explain: The low-order 32 bits carry the embedded IPv4 address.

cite.quote: Two types of IPv6 addresses are defined that carry an IPv4 address in the low-order 32 bits of the address.

intro.quote: Multicast addresses have the following format:

fields.explain: The fixed eight-bit all-ones prefix identifies a multicast address.

fields.name: flgs
fields.explain: The four-bit flag set contains a high-order reserved bit plus the R, P, and T flags. The reserved bit must be initialized to zero.

cite.quote:
flgs is a set of 4 flags:     |0|R|P|T|
                                    +-+-+-+-+

         The high-order flag is reserved, and must be initialized to 0.

fields.name: scop
fields.explain: The four-bit scope value limits the scope of the multicast group.

fields.name: group ID
fields.explain: The group ID identifies the multicast group within the given scope.
